rationale: Polishes the Plan editor's existing entry behaviour from v1.81.0: existing geometry opens Select rather than starting accidental wall drafts. Not a fix for a feature introduced only within the current release line.

summary.ru: Готовый план открывается с «Выбрать», а пустой этаж — со «Стенами».
summary.en: Existing plans open with Select; empty floors start with Walls.
